title: Chocolate Chip Cookies
steps: Heat the oven to 375°F (190°C) and line two baking sheets with parchment.
Whisk the flour, baking soda and salt in a bowl.
Beat the butter with both sugars until creamy and a little lighter, 2–3 minutes. Beat in the eggs one at a time, then the vanilla.
On low speed, mix in the flour just until no dry streaks remain, then stir in the chocolate chips.
Scoop 2-tbsp balls of dough about 5 cm apart. Bake one sheet at a time for 9–11 minutes, until the edges are golden and the centres still look slightly underdone.
Cool on the sheet for 5 minutes, then move to a rack. For thicker cookies with a deeper toffee flavour, chill the dough for up to 24 hours before baking.
